summary: A first-time canvasser begins a shift with a door shut in their face.
realLife: Charlotte Smallwood-Cook recalled her first knock as a candidate for Wyoming County district attorney in New York. She got as far as introducing herself and naming the office before the woman who answered shut the door.
inGame: needs: combine a first-outing fact with the resident ending the encounter.
gates: This is the canvasser’s first outing.

turns.what: The resident opens the door long enough to ask who sent the canvasser.
turns.pulledBy: The resident recognizes the group on the volunteer's card.
turns.writesBack: The first stop yields a brief conversation.

turns.what: The resident shuts the door on the introduction, then calls through it to ask the canvasser to take the leaflet back.
turns.pulledBy: The canvasser left a leaflet on the mat and can still hear the resident.
turns.writesBack: The canvasser retrieves it and marks the address as having declined literature.
